title: A matching supplies a cover bound
hook: A small matching can certify a lower bound on every possible cover.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Offline optimum versus online decisions; cost and approximation ratio.
doesNotKnow: Take both endpoints of a maximal matching and compare the cover size with the matching lower bound.

misconception: A greedy vertex cover has no usable bound against the optimum.
objective: Take both endpoints of a maximal matching and compare the cover size with the matching lower bound.

claims.text: Disjoint matching edges each require at least one endpoint in any vertex cover. Taking both endpoints uses twice that lower bound, and maximality ensures no uncovered edge remains. The exhaustive tiny optimum is displayed separately from the approximation.
